name: Job Search Platform
description: A unified job search platform with AI-powered job tracking and analysis capabilities

nixpacksConfig.buildCommand: cd apps/web && pnpm install && pnpm prisma generate && pnpm run build
nixpacksConfig.startCommand: cd apps/web && npx prisma migrate deploy && pnpm start

NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.description: Public API URL (will be set automatically to your Railway URL)

JWT_SECRET.description: Secret key for JWT token signing (generate a long random string)

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic Claude API key for AI features

GOOGLE_API_KEY.description: Google AI API key for Gemini (alternative AI provider)

ADZUNA_APP_ID.description: Adzuna App ID for job search API

ADZUNA_API_KEY.description: Adzuna API key for job search

LINKEDIN_RAPIDAPI_KEY.description: LinkedIn Jobs API key via RapidAPI

PYTHON_BACKEND_URL.description: Python backend service URL (auto-configured if using job-agent service)

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic Claude API key for AI agents

docs.getting_started: After deployment, your app will be available at the Railway-provided URL. Make sure to add at least one AI API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google) for full functionality.
docs.environment_variables: See .env.example in the repository for a complete list of optional environment variables.
